faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Indore Assistant Engineer (Audio Visual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Engineer (Audio Visual) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in engineering, specifically in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, IT, CS, or Audio Visual disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Assistant Engineer (Audio Visual) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Management Indore.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIM Indore located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify details regarding age relaxation. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for this information.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if I have a degree in a related engineering field?
faq.answer: The specified qualifications are Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, IT/CS/Audio Visual. For related fields, please refer to the official notification for clarification.
